2025-11-12T08:00:09.1848845Z 157      |-	
2025-11-12T08:00:09.1849120Z 158      |-	The renderer follows a reconciliation algorithm similar to React:
2025-11-12T08:00:09.1849278Z 159      |-	1. Mount phase: Create DOM from VNode tree
2025-11-12T08:00:09.1849493Z 160      |-	2. Update phase: Diff old/new VNodes and patch differences

2025-11-12T08:00:09.1849785Z 162      |-	
2025-11-12T08:00:09.1850064Z 163      |-	Each VNode tracks its corresponding Roblox Instance, event connections,
2025-11-12T08:00:09.1850337Z 164      |-	and directive state. Component VNodes track their ComponentInstance.
2025-11-12T08:00:09.1850605Z 165      |-	The diffing algorithm preserves instances when possible and only
2025-11-12T08:00:09.1850733Z 166      |-	creates/destroys as needed.

2025-11-12T08:00:09.2103031Z     155  |+	Architecture Notes:
2025-11-12T08:00:09.2103144Z     156  |+    -------------------
2025-11-12T08:00:09.2103246Z     157  |+	
2025-11-12T08:00:09.2103531Z     158  |+	The renderer follows a reconciliation algorithm similar to React:
2025-11-12T08:00:09.2103691Z     159  |+	1. Mount phase: Create DOM from VNode tree
2025-11-12T08:00:09.2103941Z     160  |+	2. Update phase: Diff old/new VNodes and patch differences

2025-11-12T08:00:09.2104279Z     162  |+

2025-11-12T08:00:09.2104929Z     164  |+	and directive state. Component VNodes track their ComponentInstance.
2025-11-12T08:00:09.2105233Z     165  |+	The diffing algorithm preserves instances when possible and only
2025-11-12T08:00:09.2105378Z     166  |+	creates/destroys as needed.
